name: 08-text-transform
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .up { text-transform: uppercase; } .lo { text-transform: lowercase; } .cap { text-transform: capitalize; } .fw { text-transform: full-width; } .sm { text-transform: small-caps; }
html:
uppercase hello World

lowercase HELLO World

capitalize hello world

full-width abc 123

small-caps Hello World
